status: development/diagnostic corpus; not sealed evaluation evidence. Graphs, features and IR verdicts are static-analysis heuristics, not compiled or executed.
reproduce: cd research/corpus-20261006 && node scripts/agentic-assemble.mjs && node scripts/merge-items.mjs && node scripts/check-items.mjs items.jsonl --canonical && node scripts/coverage-report.mjs
restore: node research/corpus-20261006/scripts/unpack.mjs (restores items.jsonl and parts/*.jsonl from the .gz copies in git and checks every sha256 below)
pack: node research/corpus-20261006/scripts/unpack.mjs --pack (rewrites a .gz only when its content differs from the manifest hash; gzip level 9, no name or timestamp)

items.distribution: too large for git (> 5 MB): publish as a release asset; it includes redistributable:false items reduced to URL + derived graph + features, which needs the owner's confirmation before publishing

sample.selection: redistributable items only: the pilot shortlist, the redistributable items among the 30 most complex (lines <= 250 kB), then a round-robin over platforms at even complexity strides, up to 5 MB

firstParty.note: workflows written by this project's own agent: not independent evidence, reported apart from third-party items and never pooled with them

sources.origin: local (first-party session scripts, no public location)

rawData.note: every item records source.rawPath; raw copies stay outside git (each cluster <= 3 GB)
